description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to the Ocdm component in the Rialto server, including a factory class for creating Ocdm instances and the Ocdm class itself, with methods for checking supported key system types.

classes.name: OcdmFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing Ocdm instances, including singleton management.

classes.name: Ocdm
classes.description: Implementation of the IOcdm interface, representing the Ocdm component with support checking functionality.

methods.name: getOcdm
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to an IOcdm instance, possibly creating or retrieving a singleton.

methods.name: isTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given key system type is supported by this Ocdm instance.
